name: MOSS-1
author: Theo Wecker
tagline: lofi, nature sounds and ambient loops for the FM-1
description: Ambient firmware with three modes. LOFI plays electric piano chords over a slow beat with tape wobble and vinyl crackle. SCAPES plays nature sounds (forest, rain, shore, night, storm, campfire, creek) with a quiet pad. DRIFT plays pads and bells on loops of different lengths. Play the keys and the music follows you: notes loop, fade and change, and a looper with four layers and eight saved slots keeps what you like. Six drum kits, a backing bass, six reverb spaces, a tape FILM knob, a sleep timer and a pixel art picture for every scene.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
